title: Bayard Rustin organises the March on Washington
summary: Bayard Rustin was the principal organiser of the 1963 March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom and a long-time adviser on nonviolent protest.
why: One of the largest civil rights demonstrations in US history.

unsung.contribution: Principal organiser of the 1963 March on Washington.
unsung.recognition: Criticised for being gay, he usually advised from behind the scenes; the Presidential Medal of Freedom came posthumously in 2013.
